newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian December RPI 0.0 pct mo/mo, 3.4 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatian December RPI 0.0 pct mo/mo, 3.4 pct y/y.

text.p: The State Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator details.
CROATIA RETAIL PRICES DEC '96 NOVEMBER DEC '95
NOTES -- Retail prices rose a total of 1.8 percent between January and December last year from the end of December 1995.
The 1996 average rise was put at an annual 3.5 percent compared to the average inflation in 1995.
Croatia introduced a radical anti-inflation programme in October 1993, when monthly inflation hit 38.7 percent. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
